resources.string: Choose where game information and artwork come from.

Free cover art, screenshots and title screens matched by system and game name. No API key is required.
Descriptions, release dates and regional artwork. Register your application at screenscraper.fr to obtain a developer ID and password.
Descriptions, release dates and artwork in English. An application API key from thegamesdb.net is required.
Exact matches can be applied during a scan. Ambiguous matches remain available for you to choose in the game details.
Application credentials are included in this build.
Optional ScreenScraper account. Requests use your account limits when signed in; guest availability depends on the service.
Enter both values of each ScreenScraper credential pair, or clear both. Check the length and remove control characters.
Keys are stored with your account credentials. Backups and TV transfers include them only when you explicitly select credentials.
